clips.title: The story
paras: In Westfall, the Defias Brotherhood's troubles reach Stormwind. Gryan Stoutmantle sends you to deliver Wiley's Note to Master Mathias Shaw, suspecting a link between the Defias and the old Stonemasons Guild.

A mention of the Stonemasons in Wiley's communications catches Gryan Stoutmantle's attention. The builders rebuilt Stormwind City after the First War, but the guild has long been thought scattered or dissolved. If the Defias Brotherhood shares ties with them, Westfall's rural insurgency is more than a disorganized band of outlaws.

From Sentinel Hill, Gryan Stoutmantle cannot confirm his suspicions. He sends you to Master Mathias Shaw, head of Stormwind's covert intelligence wing, SI:7. Shaw works from the Barracks in Old Town, gathering whispers and secrets from across the realm. He may be able to untangle the Defias Brotherhood's origins.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I wonder what Wiley meant when he mentioned the Stonemasons. Perhaps that was a slip of tongue. Could the Defias gang be related to the Stonemasons? Only one man would know for sure: Mathias Shaw, head of SI:7. Show him Wiley's Note and see if he has anything to add to this growing mystery. If you have trouble finding Shaw, check the Barracks in Old Town.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What business do you have with me? I am a very busy man...

clips.title: Completion
paras: This matter might be more complex than Stoutmantle realizes.
